description: This file defines the RolesViewList class for rendering the list view of roles within the SuiteCRM application. It extends the ViewList class and customizes the preDisplay method to initialize a ListViewSmarty object with specific properties.

classes.name: RolesViewList
classes.description: A view class responsible for rendering the roles list view, extending the base ViewList class and customizing its preDisplay behavior.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overrides the parent preDisplay method to initialize the list view and disable mass update fields.
